rust_summary: client play-state login and logout observations, including integrated connections and server transfers (`native_client_logged_in`, `native_client_logged_out`).
doc_summary: `client_logged_in(single_player, address)` runs after the client enters play: integrated connections have single_player=true and no address; remote connections carry their supplied address. Reconfiguration does not repeat login. `client_logged_out()` runs once for a logged-in connection before ordinary teardown, including a transfer; at final shutdown it follows successful exit saving. Failed login has no logout. Both run only in the window's client role. Requires native hooks API @API:client_connection@.
